title: The "vasa"
question: What happened to the 'Vasa' almost immediately after she was launched?

phrases.usage: 表示处于某个活动、状态或事业的顶峰、最鼎盛时期

examples.en: He was at the height of his career when he won the Nobel Prize.
examples.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖时，他正处于事业的顶峰。

examples.en: At the height of the summer, the temperature can reach 40℃ here.
examples.zh: 在盛夏时节，这里的温度可达40摄氏度。

phrases.usage: 表示某事物被设计、计划用于某个特定目的，主语通常是物

examples.en: This program is intended to help people with low income.
examples.zh: 这个项目旨在帮助低收入人群。

examples.en: The book is intended for children aged 5 to 10.
examples.zh: 这本书是为5到10岁的儿童编写的。

phrases.usage: 表示在某个领域、活动中起主导作用、担任重要角色

examples.en: She played a leading role in organizing the event.
examples.zh: 她在组织这次活动中起到了主导作用。

examples.en: China plays a leading role in global climate change cooperation.
examples.zh: 中国在全球气候变化合作中发挥着重要的引领作用。

phrases.usage: 用于描述大量丰富多彩、种类繁多的事物，尤指颜色

examples.en: The garden is a riot of colour in spring.
examples.zh: 春天的花园里色彩缤纷，万紫千红。

examples.en: The parade was a riot of sound and movement as dancers and musicians passed by.
examples.zh: 当舞者和音乐家经过时，游行队伍充满了喧闹的声响和活跃的身影。

phrases.usage: 表示激发、唤起某人的想象力

examples.en: Science fiction stories always stir children's imagination about space.
examples.zh: 科幻故事总能激发孩子们对太空的想象力。

examples.en: The mysterious ancient ruins stirred the archaeologists' imagination.
examples.zh: 这些神秘的古代遗迹唤起了考古学家的想象。

phrases.usage: 表示作为对……的回应、答复

examples.en: He nodded in reply to my question.
examples.zh: 他点了点头，作为对我问题的回应。

examples.en: The company issued a statement in reply to the media's accusations.
examples.zh: 公司发布了一则声明，回应媒体的指控。

phrases.usage: 表示决定了某人或某事物的最终结局（通常是不幸的），无法再改变

examples.en: His careless mistake in the final game sealed the team's fate.
examples.zh: 他在决赛中那个粗心的失误注定了球队的败局。

examples.en: When the company lost its biggest client, its fate was sealed.
examples.zh: 当公司失去了最大的客户时，它的命运就已经注定了。

sentences.en: From the seventeenth-century empire of Sweden,
sentences.zh: 17世纪的瑞典王国

sentences.en: the story of a galleon that sank at the start of her maiden voyage in 1628 must be one of the strangest tales of the sea.
sentences.zh: 一艘名为“瓦萨”的帆船在1628年首次出航时就沉没了。这个故事一定是航海史上最离奇的事件之一。

sentences.en: For nearly three and a half centuries she lay at the bottom of Stockholm harbour until her discovery in 1956.
sentences.zh: 她在斯德哥尔摩港湾海底沉睡了将近3个半世纪，直到1956年才被发现。

sentences.en: This was the Vasa, royal flagship of the great imperial fleet.
sentences.zh: 这就是“瓦萨”号，一支强大皇家舰队的旗舰。

sentences.en: King Gustavus Adolphus 'The Northern Hurricane',
sentences.zh: 国王古斯塔夫·阿道夫，人称“北方飓风”，

sentences.en: then at the height of his military success in the 'Thirty Years' War,
sentences.zh: 当时正处于“三十年战争”军事胜利的巅峰时期，

sentences.en: had dictated her measurements and armament.
sentences.zh: 亲自规定了“瓦萨”号的尺寸和武器装备。

sentences.en: Triple gun-decks mounted sixty-four bronze cannon.
sentences.zh: 三层炮甲板上装载着64门青铜大炮。

sentences.en: She was intended to play a leading role in the growing might of Sweden.
sentences.zh: 她注定要在瑞典日益壮大的国力中扮演重要角色。

sentences.en: As she was prepared for her maiden voyage on August 10, 1628, Stockholm was in a ferment.
sentences.zh: 1628年8月10日，“瓦萨”号准备首次航行，斯德哥尔摩一片沸腾。

sentences.en: From the Skeppsbron and surrounding islands
sentences.zh: 从海事博物馆码头和周围的岛屿，

sentences.en: the people watched this thing of beauty begin to spread her sails and catch the wind.
sentences.zh: 人们看着这艘美丽的船开始张帆起航，乘风破浪。

sentences.en: They had laboured for three years to produce this floating work of art;
sentences.zh: 人们辛劳了3年才建造出这艘漂浮的艺术品；

sentences.en: she was more richly carved and ornamented than any previous ship.
sentences.zh: 她比以往任何一艘船都雕刻得更精美，装饰得更华丽。

sentences.en: The high stern castle was a riot of carved gods, demons, knights, kings, warriors,
sentences.zh: 高高的船尾楼雕刻着众神、恶魔、骑士、国王、武士、

sentences.en: mermaids, cherubs; and zoomorphic animal shapes ablaze with red and gold and blue,
sentences.zh: 美人鱼、小天使；还有栩栩如生的动物造型，它们都被漆成红、金和蓝色，

sentences.en: symbols of courage, power, and cruelty,
sentences.zh: 象征着勇气、力量和残酷，

sentences.en: were portrayed to stir the imaginations of the superstitious sailors of the day.
sentences.zh: 旨在激发当时迷信水手们的想象力。

sentences.en: Then the cannons of the anchored warships thundered a salute to which the Vasa fired in reply.
sentences.zh: 锚泊的军舰鸣炮致敬，“瓦萨”号也鸣炮回敬。

sentences.en: As she emerged from her drifting cloud of gun smoke with the water churned to foam beneath her bow,
sentences.zh: 当她从漂浮的硝烟中驶出，船头下的水花翻腾成泡沫，

sentences.en: her flags flying, pennants waving, sails filling in the breeze,
sentences.zh: 旗帜飘扬，三角旗招展，风帆鼓满，

sentences.en: and the red and gold or her superstructure ablaze with colour,
sentences.zh: 红金相间的上层建筑色彩斑斓，

sentences.en: she presented a more majestic spectacle than Stockholmers had ever seen before.
sentences.zh: 她展现出斯德哥尔摩人前所未见的雄伟景象。

sentences.en: All gun-ports were open and the muzzles peeped wickedly from them.
sentences.zh: 所有的炮门都敞开着，炮口不怀好意地探出。

sentences.en: As the wind freshened there came a sudden squall and the ship made a strange movement, listing to port.
sentences.zh: 随着风势渐强，一阵突如其来的飑风袭来，船身做了一个奇怪的动作，向左舷倾斜。

sentences.en: The Ordnance officer ordered all the port cannon to be heaved to starboard
sentences.zh: 炮兵军官命令将所有左舷的大炮都移到右舷，

sentences.en: to counteract the list but the steepening angle of the decks increased.
sentences.zh: 以抵消倾斜，但甲板的倾斜角度反而加剧了。

sentences.en: Then the sound of rumbling thunder reached the watchers on the shore,
sentences.zh: 接着，隆隆的雷鸣声传到了岸上的观望者耳中，

sentences.en: as cargo, ballast, ammunition and 400 people went sliding and crashing down to the port side of the steeply listing ship.
sentences.zh: 原来是货物、压舱物、弹药和400名船员滑向急剧倾斜的船只的左舷，发出撞击声。

sentences.en: The lower gun-ports were now below water and the inrush sealed the ship's fate.
sentences.zh: 下层炮门现在已在水面之下，涌入的海水注定了这艘船的命运。

sentences.en: In that first glorious hour, the mighty Vasa, which was intended to rule the Baltic,
sentences.zh: 在那光荣的第一个小时，原本注定要称霸波罗的海的“瓦萨”号，

sentences.en: sank with all flags flying--in the harbour of her birth.
sentences.zh: 带着所有飘扬的旗帜，沉入了她诞生时的港口。

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句
grammar.definition: 对主句中某个名词或整个主句的内容进行补充说明，去掉后不影响主句的完整意思，通常和主句之间用逗号隔开
grammar.usage: 用于补充额外信息，而非限定修饰的对象，翻译时通常拆分为独立的句子

examples.en: In that first glorious hour, the mighty Vasa, which was intended to rule the Baltic, sank with all flags flying.
examples.zh: 在那荣耀的第一个小时里，本打算统治波罗的海的强大的“瓦萨”号，却在自己的诞生港内，全旗飘扬地沉入了海底。

examples.en: The old building, which was built in 1890, will be turned into a museum next year.
examples.zh: 这栋老建筑建于1890年，明年将被改造成一座博物馆。

grammar.title: with的复合结构作伴随状语
grammar.definition: 用"with + 宾语 + 宾语补足语"的结构，描述主句动作发生时的伴随状态、背景或原因
grammar.structure: with + 名词/代词 + 现在分词/过去分词/形容词/副词/介词短语/不定式
grammar.usage: 用于丰富句子的场景描述，让多个动作或状态同时呈现，避免堆砌多个简单句

examples.en: As she emerged from her drifting cloud of gun smoke with the water churned to foam beneath her bow, her flags flying, pennants waving, sails filling in the breeze, and the red and gold of her superstructure ablaze with colour, she presented a more majestic spectacle than Stockholmers had ever seen before.
examples.zh: 当它从弥漫的炮烟中驶出时，船首下的海水翻滚着泡沫，旗帜飘扬，三角旗舞动，风帆在微风中胀满，上层建筑的红金两色光彩夺目，它呈现出斯德哥尔摩人前所未见的雄伟景象。

examples.en: She walked into the classroom with a book in her hand and a smile on her face.
examples.zh: 她走进教室，手里拿着一本书，脸上带着微笑。

grammar.title: 时间状语从句的省略
grammar.definition: 当时间状语从句的主语和主句主语一致，且从句包含be动词时，可以省略从句的主语和be动词，简化句子结构
grammar.structure: when/while/as/once/until/if等 + 现在分词/过去分词/形容词/介词短语
grammar.usage: 用于避免重复主语，让句子更简洁紧凑

examples.en: As prepared for her maiden voyage on August 10, 1628, Stockholm was in a ferment.
examples.zh: 1628年8月10日，当它正准备首次航行时，斯德哥尔摩全城沸腾。

examples.en: When asked about his plan, he said he would go abroad for further study.
examples.zh: 当被问及他的计划时，他说他会出国深造。

patterns.pattern: The story of ... that ... must be one of the strangest tales of ...

original.en: the story of a galleon that sank at the start of her maiden voyage in 1628 must be one of the strangest tales of the sea.
original.zh: 1628年一艘大帆船在处女航刚开始就沉没了，这个故事堪称航海史上最离奇的传说之一。

examples.en: The story of a young painter that died poor but became world-famous after his death must be one of the strangest tales of the art world.
examples.zh: 一位年轻画家生前穷困潦倒，去世后却举世闻名，这个故事堪称艺术界最离奇的传说之一。

examples.en: The story of an old cat that traveled 500 kilometers to return to its owner's home must be one of the strangest tales of animal behavior.
examples.zh: 一只老猫跋涉500公里回到主人家，这个故事堪称动物行为中最离奇的传说之一。

original.en: the mighty Vasa, which was intended to rule the Baltic, sank with all flags flying--in the harbour of her birth.
original.zh: 本打算统治波罗的海的强大的“瓦萨”号，却在自己的诞生港内，全旗飘扬地沉入了海底。

examples.en: The grand project, which was intended to solve the city's traffic problem, was stopped due to lack of funds.
examples.zh: 本打算解决城市交通问题的宏大项目，却因为资金不足被叫停了。

examples.en: The new policy, which was intended to encourage small businesses, has received widespread support.
examples.zh: 本打算鼓励小微企业的新政策，得到了广泛的支持。

original.en: As the wind freshened there came a sudden squall and the ship made a strange movement, listing to port.
original.zh: 当风力增强时，突然刮来一阵狂风，船奇怪地晃动了一下，向左舷倾斜。

examples.en: As the meeting was going smoothly there came a sudden objection from a young participant.
examples.zh: 当会议进展顺利时，突然有一位年轻的参会者提出了反对意见。

examples.en: As we were enjoying the picnic there came a sudden heavy rain and we had to rush to the car.
examples.zh: 我们正享受野餐的时候，突然下起了大雨，我们不得不冲向车里。
